messages:
Leah (PM): Quick sync — I've sketched an alpha slice for the toolkit: 1) batching advisory, 2) prefix/KV caching, 3) quant recommendation profiles, 4) eval-triggered quality alerts. Need to pick minimal acceptance criteria for alpha pilot. Thoughts?
Sanjay (ML Eng): +1 on those pillars. For alpha we should limit to: a) heuristics for batch size per model family, b) cache TTL + warmup hit-rate metric, c) 1 quantization recipe (8-bit) for Llama-variants, d) eval-alerts for concordance drop >5%.
Raj (Infra): Important: infra needs SLOs for suggestions endpoint. Can we guarantee <100ms median for lookup? Also need rollout flagging in Dedicated.
Emma (Product Ops): Customers keep asking for explainer text in UI. Alpha should include actionable rationale for each rec, not just numbers. Also need a simple opt-out per route.
Leah (PM): Agree. Propose acceptance lines: - Suggestions API <=150ms p50, - batch recs yield >=10% inferred token-cost reduction in 10/20 pilot workloads, - cache hit >=30% within 1 hour, - quant rec validated on 3 benchmark prompts w/o >3% quality loss, - eval-alerts fire with actionable triggers (concordance, rouge or custom prompt sets).
Sanjay (ML Eng): Note: "quality loss" depends on metric. For chat we'll use human-likeness concordance; for seq2seq tasks maybe ROUGE. I'll add a minimal eval harness. Example alert rule snippet:
```
alert_rule: {
  name: "concordance_drop",
  window: "24h",
  threshold: "5%",
  action: "notify:product_ops, fallback_model:small-v1"
}
```
Raj (Infra): Ops: we'll need feature-flag keys, and a fallback path to host-models when recommenders fail. Also rate-limit suggestions to avoid tight loops. I'll add quotas 100 rps per customer by default.
Emma (Product Ops): For rollout: phased 10%, 50%, 100% with canary metrics. Need a checklist for customer opt-in and data handling (KMS notes). Who owns the customer comms?
Leah (PM): Product will draft comms, but SEs will own onboarding. Action items: Leah draft alpha PRD by Tue; Sanjay prototype eval harness + sample alerts; Raj add flags/quotas; Emma draft comms templates. Anyone want to add more constraints?
Sanjay (ML Eng): Add one more: logging of inputs to suggestions must be opt-in and scrubbed; no raw PII.
Leah (PM): Noted. Final Q — timeline: can we ship alpha to internal pilots in 6 weeks? :thinking_face:
Raj (Infra): Tight but doable if we scope to one model family and a single region. I'll block infra capacity.
Emma (Product Ops): I'll line up two pilot customers and legal review.
Leah (PM): Great. I'll create the PRD thread and tag people. :rocket:
ops-bot: Deployment window scheduled for 2025-06-15 02:00 UTC (provisional). Reaction: :white_check_mark:
Leah (PM): thanks — closing this thread, moving to PRD draft.
